why: Run L4 sub-run L4d's leftovers that no later run L4 area owns.

items.text: GET /inbox calls rt.startCheck once for each open plan card only to read workBudgetUsdMicro (a route R-inboxperf optimised).

setPersonZone runs inside the store reducer (a side effect): a screen rendered before /me answers is not re-rendered when the zone arrives, and a zone saved in Settings is read again only after a restart or a project switch.
L4a-left-4's queued-continuation status line has no real-daemon case; other '(s)' literals remain outside intake.ts and calibration.ts; the plan card foot line is about 104-117 characters under ask.
Task rows show 'CHF 0.00' for unspent tasks.

for_session_lead.live_checks_for_F: Under 'ask' with the real subscription at its limit mid-session: compare the ask card's 'about CHF N' with the Start dialog's Use API key figure, then the actual spend after the yes.
